evals.prompt: I want to spin up an autonomous research project on whether sparse attention hurts long-context retrieval. Set it up and just start running.
evals.expected_output: Sets up the continuity loop first (/loop or heartbeat), creates the workspace (research-state.yaml, research-log.md, findings.md, literature/, src/, data/), bootstraps with literature search and hypotheses, locks the metric and baseline, then enters the inner experiment loop without asking for permission.

evals.prompt: I have a research-state.yaml and findings.md in ~/proj/grokking-wd from last week. Weight decay sweeps on modular addition (H1 supported, H2 inconclusive) and about 12 runs logged in data/trajectory_H1_runs001-012.csv. Pick up where we left off.
evals.expected_output: Reads research-state.yaml and findings.md (including Lessons and Constraints) to resume. Does an outer-loop synthesis of the 12 runs, decides DEEPEN/BROADEN/PIVOT/CONCLUDE (e.g. sub-hypotheses for H1, resolving H2), updates findings.md and the log, and continues the inner loop, routing to domain skills as needed.

evals.prompt: I'm going to be offline for a few days. Can you keep investigating why my small transformer's loss spikes early in training, running experiments on your own, testing ideas, and then writing up what you find with a summary deck I can look at when I'm back?
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a long-horizon autonomous multi-hypothesis project. Sets up a continuity mechanism, forms testable hypotheses, runs iterated experiments, periodically synthesizes results, produces progress presentations, and works toward a findings document or paper without waiting for user confirmation.

evals.prompt: I want to build a visual workflow agent in AutoGPT that monitors RSS feeds and posts summaries to Slack, and deploy it so it runs continuously.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as building and deploying a persistent automation agent on the AutoGPT platform, not running a research project. Uses the autogpt-agents skill for block-based workflow setup and deployment.

evals.prompt: Write a LoRA fine-tuning script for Llama on my 5k-example instruction dataset with Hugging Face PEFT, and fix the CUDA OOM error I get at batch size 8.
evals.expected_output: Gives a concrete single-task answer: a PEFT LoRA training script plus OOM fixes (smaller batch, gradient accumulation, gradient checkpointing, mixed precision). It does not set up a multi-loop research project.
